description: Gets rendering definition on an item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

finalLayout.description: Target the final layout (default true), where list-renderings' uniqueIds live. False = shared only.

id.description: The id of the item to retrieve rendering for. Supply this or path.

path.description: The path of the item to retrieve rendering for. Supply this or id.

name: presentation-get-rendering
